name: Juche
summary: Juche is the official state doctrine of North Korea: man, in the form of the masses led by their party and supreme leader, is master of his destiny, so a nation must stand on its own in ideology, politics, economy and defence. In the Kim Jong-il era it combines a planned, state-owned economy built on heavy industry, one-party rule under a hereditary leader, collective duties ahead of individual rights, and hostility to great-power domination.
scope: The canonical doctrine of Kim Il-sung's 1955 speech and Kim Jong-il's 1982 treatise, the 1998 DPRK constitution, and the sustained record of the DPRK as the state where it is official doctrine (record answers over words where it speaks). Songun and later Kim Jong-un revisions are not the basis, and foreign Juche study groups are excluded.
